_comment: HUD region rects, authored as FRACTIONS of the 16:9 reference canvas (x,y,w,h in 0..1), mapped to the window's 16:9 safe area at render (see HudCanvas / docs/design/HUD.md). Screen-fixed overlay bands: THOUGHT upper (subjective, faculty-hued), OBSERVATION/ACTION lower (objective + action menu), NOTIFICATION right at the lower-band top. Tune these by feel. visibility: 'auto' draws a region only when it holds content (calm default); 'on' shows always-on region frames; 'off' hides the HUD. Later flipped from the Settings menu.
